_notes: lanePREWARM v92. Read by Scripts/Prewarm92.cs (HudCfg.ReadData). Extends FxPrewarm (C1 caps + piece stub, GoreFx, ClashFx...) with the parts it did not cover: finisher cleave materials, finisher Volume overrides (NoMotionBlur / Vignette / Exposure), finisher + all Animator clips touched, ragdoll joint stub, wound decal materials, loot pillar/ground materials+textures, loot IMGUI fonts+glyphs, plus a hitch watcher that logs any frame longer than hitchMs. Every step has its own switch. Sub-pixel size / distance / draw frames come from perf.json (prewarmSize, prewarmDistance, prewarmFrames). Command line: -noprewarm92 (all off, for the A/B), -prewarm92harness (also in proof/loop runs). Batch mode: always off.

volumes.note: weight 0 global Volume with MotionBlur + Vignette + the finisher exposure override (FinisherLook.DarkenExposure), same component types as FinisherCamera.SetNoBlur / FinisherVignette.Begin. Priority is below the real ones (10000 / 10001) and weight 0: the picture cannot change.

ragdollStub.note: kinematic root + N dynamic capsule bodies chained with ConfigurableJoint (slerp drive), no gravity, no collisions detected, 5 km below the arena, destroyed after frames. Same component set as RagdollDeath.Build. Only runs when ragdoll.json enabled (RagdollDeath.Cfg.enabled) or stubAlways.

goreFx.note: FINFIX v93: the finisher's real neck + wound sprays (all particle modules, strand material) emitted sub-pixel 80 m in front of the camera for ~3 draw frames.

cutDry.note: FINFIX v93: MeshCut.Prepare (the staged cut) run to the end on each real fighter in 6 ms slices, then discarded: nothing is applied. Pays the first-use / JIT cost at the start of the fight.

hitch.note: logs '[Prewarm92] HITCH <ms> ms ...' for any frame longer than hitchMs (unscaled, after the prewarm has started). VERIFY.md greps it.
